# The board cycles' gate values

One row per board cycle (`nx ledger series add build/logs/board--<id>/uart.log`), newest last. The device server prints the last row as `last=` on its gate lines and a value worse by more than 10 % is `FAIL … slower than last` naming that cycle. Times in microseconds.
